# TensorFlow.js WASM backend 4.22.0

Unmodified browser distribution of `@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-wasm@4.22.0` from the official npm registry. The JavaScript bundle and three WASM variants are served alongside the existing TensorFlow.js 4.22.0 and BlazePose weights. The registry tarball integrity was verified before extraction.

Copyright Google LLC and TensorFlow.js contributors. Apache-2.0; see the license header in the JavaScript bundle and the [upstream package](https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs/tree/tfjs-v4.22.0/tfjs-backend-wasm).
